title: The b-config-read-adjacent defect, hidden inside a realistic multi-hunk commit
changeCommitMessage: store: write configs atomically and centralise the profile layout
claim: writeConfig in src/store.mjs now writes to a temporary file and renames it into place, so a write that fails partway leaves the previous config in place rather than a half-written one. test/store.test.mjs covers the round-trip and asserts no temporary file is left behind, and passes.

defect.summary: The same commit widened readConfig's catch from ENOENT to every error, so a corrupt or unreadable config now returns {} and the next writeConfig overwrites the original with it.
